A canonical tag is like a 'this is my official address' signal sent to Google, preventing confusion if the same page can be reached multiple ways. priorityActions.action: Add a visible H1 headline to your homepage – this is the main title Google reads to understand what your page is about. Something like 'Lebanon's Home for Toys & Children's Products' works perfectly.

priorityActions.action: Add a canonical tag to your homepage. This is a single line of code that tells Google which version of your website is the 'official' one, preventing your own pages from competing against each other in search results.

priorityActions.action: Fix the duplicate page titles on your category pages – right now 'Arts & Crafts' and 'Clothing' both show 'Toys R Us | All products' as their title. priorityActions.why: When Google sees multiple pages with identical titles, it cannot tell them apart and will rank them poorly – you are currently losing potential shoppers searching specifically for arts & crafts or clothing for children.
